description: The Champion uses excellence in combat to overcome enemies through superior technique.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Critical hit range increases from 20 to 19-20.

features.name: Superior Technique
features.description: When you roll for attack, you can use this feature to grant yourself advantage.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Add half proficiency to ability checks you are not proficient in.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: Learn a second Fighting Style feat.
